summary.text: On Zendikar, the Eldrazi titans are loose and overrun places like Sea Gate, and Nissa Revane is left unable to feel the world after her connection to Zendikar is torn away.

Gideon Jura is named Commander-General of the Zendikari by the dying Vorik and rallies the survivors to retake Sea Gate rather than flee, while Nissa finds Zendikar's soul trapped in the Khalni Heart and frees it.
Jace traps Ulamog with the hedrons, but Ob Nixilis knocks them out of alignment and wakes Kozilek, and Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together as the Gatewatch.
